title: From Susceptibility Loci to Therapeutic Targets: The Genetic Architecture of IgA Nephropathy.
snippet: IgA nephropathy is the most common primary glomerulonephritis worldwide and a leading cause of chronic kidney disease and kidney failure in young and middle-aged adults, characterized by considerable ethnic differences in incidence and prognosis. title: Advances in Urinary Liquid Biopsy: A Review of Emerging Sensing Platforms for Early Cancer Screening and Diagnosis.
snippet: Early screening of many types of cancers remains limited by the invasiveness of gold-standard tissue biopsies and the poor specificity of traditional clinical biomarkers like prostate-specific antigen (PSA).
